column1: # Names we assign to functions in jetsetradio.exe. tools/map_functions.py merges them into
# data/function_map.tsv. A name here replaces an RTTI slot name (Class::vfN); one that differs from the name
# a function's own string gives stops the script. One row per function, tab-separated:
# address, name, module (the source file if known, else empty), call and args (the calling
# convention and the count of 4-byte stack arguments, needed before a function is reimplemented
# or overridden; else empty), note. The note says what the function does that earns the name, and
# where that was seen, and for call and args what shows them. See "Naming functions" in AGENTS.md.

column6: Advances a file load by one state each frame; state 4 waits while File_GetStatus is 2 (reading). M2, second boot (call trace of the Loading hang)
References the paths of the MIDI sound banks' Ogg files (MIDI/*_seq/*.ogg); the body of Audio_LoaderThread. M2, second boot
Thread procedure: runs Audio_LoadMidiBanks, clears the busy flag at 0x009CDD7E, returns. M2, second boot
Input set-up: GetModuleHandleA(NULL), then DirectInput8Create, then the device's methods; never checks the HRESULT. M2, first boot
Returns the sector count of the last completed read (+0x10) for a file slot, or 0 for a closed slot. Shape of CRI's ADXF_GetNumReadSct, unconfirmed
Returns a file slot's status (+0x1C): 2 while reading, 3 when the read is done; 0 for a closed slot. Shape of CRI's ADXF_GetStat, unconfirmed
Starts an overlapped ReadFile of N 2,048-byte sectors into a buffer passed through MapDCAddress, sets the status to 2, returns N; ignores ReadFile's result. M2, second boot

For each of the 16 file slots that is reading and whose OVERLAPPED.Internal is no longer STATUS_PENDING: GetOverlappedResult, advance the position, set the status to 3, run the slot's callback. M2, second boot

Maps a Dreamcast main-RAM address (0x8C000000-0x8CFFFFFF) into the 16 MB block that CApplication::MapDCMemory allocates at 0x20000000; any other address passes through. M2, second boot. cdecl with 1 argument: it reads one argument from the stack, returns in eax, pops only its return address, and writes ecx before reading it, so ecx carries nothing in (the lift, at the pin)
